select
  (select jsonb_object_agg(s.key, s.value) from public.app_settings s) as settings,
  to_char(now() at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh', 'YYYY-MM-DD') as today,
  coalesce((
    select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'candidate_id', c.candidate_id, 'full_name', c.full_name, 'email', c.email, 'job_id', c.job_id,
      'job_title', j.title, 'department', j.department, 'hiring_manager', j.hiring_manager, 'is_sample', c.is_sample,
      'hired_on', (select to_char(max(e.occurred_at) at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh', 'YYYY-MM-DD') from public.candidate_events e
                    where e.candidate_id = c.candidate_id and e.to_status = 'hired'),
      'email_taken', exists (select 1 from public.employees x where lower(x.email) = lower(c.email)),
      'ai_summary', a.summary, 'skills_to_verify', a.skills_to_verify, 'declared_role', a.declared_role,
      'templates', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('template_id', t.template_id, 'task_name', t.task_name,
                     'category', t.category, 'owner_role', t.owner_role, 'due_offset_days', t.due_offset_days, 'course_id', t.course_id)
                     order by t.due_offset_days, t.template_id)
                   from public.onboarding_templates t where t.job_id = c.job_id and t.status = 'active'), '[]'::jsonb)
    ) order by c.candidate_id)
    from public.candidates c
    join public.jobs j on j.job_id = c.job_id
    left join lateral (select y.summary, y.skills_to_verify, y.declared_role from public.cv_analyses y
                       where y.candidate_id = c.candidate_id order by y.analyzed_at desc limit 1) a on true
    where c.status = 'hired' and not exists (select 1 from public.employees x where x.candidate_id = c.candidate_id)
  ), '[]'::jsonb) as pending,
  coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('course_id', k.course_id, 'course_name', k.name, 'skill', k.skill, 'job_id', k.job_id,
              'level', k.level, 'prerequisite_course_id', k.prerequisite_id, 'duration_hours', k.duration_hours,
              'cost_vnd', k.cost_vnd, 'material_url', k.material_url) order by k.course_id)
            from public.courses k where k.status = 'active'), '[]'::jsonb) as catalog;

parameters.query:
with p as (select $1::jsonb as j),
emp as (
  insert into public.employees (candidate_id, job_id, full_name, email, start_date, manager, buddy, is_sample)
  select p.j->>'candidate_id', p.j->>'job_id', p.j->>'full_name', p.j->>'email', (p.j->>'start_date')::date,
         nullif(p.j->>'manager', ''), nullif(p.j->>'buddy', ''), coalesce((p.j->>'is_sample')::boolean, false)
  from p
  on conflict (candidate_id) do nothing
  returning employee_id
),
tasks as (
  insert into public.onboarding_tasks (employee_id, template_id, task_name, category, owner_role, due_date, course_id)
  select emp.employee_id, nullif(t->>'template_id', ''), t->>'task_name', t->>'category', t->>'owner_role',
         (t->>'due_date')::date, nullif(t->>'course_id', '')
  from emp, p, jsonb_array_elements(p.j->'tasks') as t
  returning task_id
),
trs as (
  insert into public.trainings (employee_id, course_id, source, assigned_on, due_on, cost_vnd, note)
  select emp.employee_id, r->>'course_id', r->>'source', (r->>'assigned_on')::date, nullif(r->>'due_on', '')::date,
         nullif(r->>'cost_vnd', '')::numeric, nullif(r->>'note', '')
  from emp, p, jsonb_array_elements(p.j->'trainings') as r
  returning training_id
)
select (select employee_id from emp) as employee_id,
       (select count(*) from tasks)::int as task_count,
       (select count(*) from trs)::int as training_count;

insert into public.automation_logs (workflow, entity_id, event, level, message, n8n_execution_id)
select 'WF2', nullif(x->>'entity_id', ''), x->>'event', x->>'level', x->>'message', $2
from jsonb_array_elements($1::jsonb) as x
returning log_id;

select
  (select jsonb_object_agg(s.key, s.value) from public.app_settings s) as settings,
  nullif($1, '') as only_employee,
  $2::boolean as force,
  to_char(now() at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh', 'YYYY-MM-DD') as today,
  coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('task_id', t.task_id, 'employee_id', t.employee_id, 'task_name', t.task_name,
     'category', t.category, 'owner_role', t.owner_role, 'due_date', t.due_date, 'status', t.status,
     'completed_on', t.completed_on, 'course_id', t.course_id, 'last_reminded_on', t.last_reminded_on)
     order by t.employee_id, t.due_date, t.task_id)
   from public.onboarding_tasks t join public.employees e on e.employee_id = t.employee_id
   where e.employment_status <> 'resigned' and ($1 = '' or t.employee_id = $1)), '[]'::jsonb) as tasks,
  coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('employee_id', e.employee_id, 'full_name', e.full_name, 'email', e.email,
     'manager', e.manager, 'buddy', e.buddy, 'department', j.department, 'tools_access', e.tools_access) order by e.employee_id)
   from public.employees e join public.jobs j on j.job_id = e.job_id
   where e.employment_status <> 'resigned' and ($1 = '' or e.employee_id = $1)), '[]'::jsonb) as employees,
  coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('training_id', r.training_id, 'employee_id', r.employee_id,
     'course_id', r.course_id, 'status', r.status, 'validity_days', k.validity_days) order by r.training_id)
   from public.trainings r join public.courses k on k.course_id = r.course_id
   where r.status <> 'completed' and ($1 = '' or r.employee_id = $1)), '[]'::jsonb) as trainings;

with p as (select $1::jsonb as j),
t as (
  update public.onboarding_tasks o set last_reminded_on = (p.j->>'today')::date
  from p where o.task_id in (select jsonb_array_elements_text(p.j->'remind_task_ids'))
  returning 1
),
e as (
  update public.employees x set tools_access = v->>'tools_access'
  from p, jsonb_array_elements(p.j->'employees') as v
  where x.employee_id = v->>'employee_id' and x.tools_access is distinct from v->>'tools_access'
  returning 1
),
r as (
  update public.trainings x set status = 'completed', completed_on = (v->>'completed_on')::date,
         certificate_expires_on = nullif(v->>'certificate_expires_on', '')::date
  from p, jsonb_array_elements(p.j->'trainings') as v
  where x.training_id = v->>'training_id' and x.status <> 'completed'
  returning 1
)
select (select count(*) from t)::int as tasks_reminded,
       (select count(*) from e)::int as employees_changed,
       (select count(*) from r)::int as trainings_completed;

select
  (select jsonb_object_agg(s.key, s.value) from public.app_settings s) as settings,
  to_char(now() at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh', 'YYYY-MM-DD') as today,
  coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('employee_id', e.employee_id, 'full_name', e.full_name, 'email', e.email,
     'job_id', e.job_id, 'department', j.department, 'manager', e.manager, 'start_date', e.start_date,
     'task_total', (select count(*) from public.onboarding_tasks t where t.employee_id = e.employee_id),
     'task_done', (select count(*) from public.onboarding_tasks t where t.employee_id = e.employee_id and t.status = 'done'),
     'course_total', (select count(*) from public.trainings r where r.employee_id = e.employee_id),
     'course_done', (select count(*) from public.trainings r where r.employee_id = e.employee_id and r.status = 'completed'))
     order by e.employee_id)
   from public.employees e join public.jobs j on j.job_id = e.job_id
   where e.employment_status = 'probation'), '[]'::jsonb) as employees;

parameters.query:
insert into public.automation_logs (workflow, entity_id, event, level, message, n8n_execution_id)
select 'WF2', nullif(x->>'entity_id', ''), x->>'event', x->>'level', x->>'message', $2
from jsonb_array_elements($1::jsonb) as x
returning log_id;

select
  (select jsonb_object_agg(s.key, s.value) from public.app_settings s) as settings,
  to_char(now() at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh', 'YYYY-MM-DD') as today,
  to_jsonb(t) as task,
  case when e.employee_id is null then null else jsonb_build_object('employee_id', e.employee_id, 'full_name', e.full_name,
    'email', e.email, 'manager', e.manager, 'department', j.department) end as employee
from (select 1) as one
left join public.onboarding_tasks t on t.task_id = upper(btrim($1))
left join public.employees e on e.employee_id = t.employee_id
left join public.jobs j on j.job_id = e.job_id;

with p as (select $1::jsonb as j),
u as (
  update public.onboarding_tasks o set
    status = p.j->>'status',
    employee_note = coalesce(nullif(p.j->>'employee_note', ''), o.employee_note),
    submitted_at = case when p.j->>'status' = 'submitted' then now() else o.submitted_at end,
    proof_name = case when p.j->>'status' = 'submitted' then nullif(p.j->>'proof_name', '') else o.proof_name end,
    proof_url = case when p.j->>'status' = 'submitted' then nullif(p.j->>'proof_url', '') else o.proof_url end,
    hr_review = case when p.j->>'status' = 'submitted' then null else o.hr_review end,
    hr_note = case when p.j->>'status' = 'submitted' then null else o.hr_note end,
    reviewed_at = case when p.j->>'status' = 'submitted' then null else o.reviewed_at end
  from p
  where o.task_id = p.j->>'task_id' and o.status not in ('done', 'submitted')
  returning o.status
)
select (select count(*) from u)::int as updated, (select status from u limit 1) as status;

insert into public.automation_logs (workflow, entity_id, event, level, message, n8n_execution_id)
select 'WF2', nullif(x->>'entity_id', ''), x->>'event', x->>'level', x->>'message', $2
from jsonb_array_elements($1::jsonb) as x
returning log_id;

select
  (select jsonb_object_agg(s.key, s.value) from public.app_settings s) as settings,
  to_char(now() at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh', 'YYYY-MM-DD') as today,
  to_jsonb(t) as task,
  case when e.employee_id is null then null else jsonb_build_object('employee_id', e.employee_id, 'full_name', e.full_name,
    'email', e.email, 'manager', e.manager, 'department', j.department) end as employee
from (select 1) as one
left join public.onboarding_tasks t on t.task_id = upper(btrim($1))
left join public.employees e on e.employee_id = t.employee_id
left join public.jobs j on j.job_id = e.job_id;

with p as (select $1::jsonb as j),
u as (
  update public.onboarding_tasks o set
    status = case when p.j->>'decision' = 'approved' then 'done' else 'in_progress' end,
    completed_on = case when p.j->>'decision' = 'approved' then (now() at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date else null end,
    hr_review = p.j->>'decision',
    hr_note = nullif(p.j->>'hr_note', ''),
    reviewed_at = now()
  from p
  where o.task_id = p.j->>'task_id' and o.status = 'submitted'
  returning o.status
)
select (select count(*) from u)::int as updated, (select status from u limit 1) as status;

insert into public.automation_logs (workflow, entity_id, event, level, message, n8n_execution_id)
select 'WF2', nullif(x->>'entity_id', ''), x->>'event', x->>'level', x->>'message', $2
from jsonb_array_elements($1::jsonb) as x
returning log_id;

parameters.content:
# WORKFLOW 2 — ONBOARDING & ĐÀO TẠO (PostgreSQL)

Bản sao của WF2 đọc/ghi Supabase thay cho Google Sheets. Bản Sheets cũ vẫn giữ nguyên.

| Nhánh | Khi nào chạy | Làm gì |
|---|---|---|
| **A** | 08:00 hằng ngày | Ứng viên `hired` chưa có hồ sơ nhân viên → tạo `employees`, `onboarding_tasks`, `trainings` (một giao dịch), mail chào mừng |
| **B** | 08:30 thứ 2–6 | Quét tiến độ → nhắc nhân viên (có nút Báo cáo), báo HR việc của bộ phận khác; đồng bộ quyền công cụ và khoá học |
| **C** | 09:00 hằng ngày | Đủ ngày thử việc + xong checklist + xong đào tạo → `official` |
| **G** | nhân viên bấm nút | `/webhook/bao-cao-task-pg`: nộp tệp / link / ghi chú → `submitted` → mời HR duyệt |
| **H** | HR bấm nút | `/webhook/hr-duyet-pg`: duyệt → `done`, trả lại → `in_progress` kèm nhận xét |

## Cấu hình nằm trong bảng `app_settings`

`webhook_base`, `link_secret`, `hr_notify_email`, `wf2_dry_run`, `wf2_send_to_real_email`, `demo_email`, `probation_days`, `reminder_warn_days`, `reminder_cooldown_days`, `blocked_cooldown_days`, `proof_drive_folder_id`, `require_proof`, `training_ai`.

Đổi giá trị: `update app_settings set value = '<json>' where key = '<khoá>';` — không cần sửa workflow.

Mọi lần chạy ghi vào `automation_logs` (workflow = 'WF2').
